nodes.description: Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint amount) that forwards tokens from _msgSender() via _transfer
Public ERC20 transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount) that moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance
Private _transfer(from, to, amount) enforcing bot/trading checks, launch-window limits, impact fee and triggering swap+send of accumulated ETH
Private swapTokensForEth(tokenAmount) that approves and swaps contract tokens on the Uniswap router, guarded by lockTheSwap
Private sendETHToFee(amount) sending contract ETH to the _FeeCollectionADD payout address
Private _tokenTransfer(sender, recipient, amount, takefee, buy) computing fee and performing the standard transfer
Private view _getFee(takefee, buy) selecting buy or sell fee percentage
Private _transferStandard(sender, recipient, amount, fee) mutating balances, taking team fee and emitting Transfer
Private pure _getValues(amount, teamFee) splitting amount into transferAmount and team fee
Private _takeTeam(team) crediting the collected fee to the contract address
External unrestricted manualswap() that swaps the whole contract token balance for ETH
External unrestricted manualsend() that pushes the whole contract ETH balance to the fee address
Owner-restricted setFeeRate(rate) that also requires _msgSender() == _FeeCollectionADD, updating _feeRate
Owner-only setFees(buy, sell) requiring new fees to be lower than current ones
Owner-only toggleImpactFee(onoff) switching _useImpactFeeSetter
Owner-only updateTaxAdd(newAddress) changing the ETH fee collection address
Owner-only setBots(bots_) marking addresses as bots that cannot transfer
Owner-only delBots(bots_) clearing bot flags
Owner-only createPair() wiring the Uniswap V2 router and creating the trading pair
Owner-only openTrading() adding liquidity via the router, enabling trading and recording _launchedAt
Private _approve(owner, spender, amount) writing the allowance mapping

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit from address of transfer
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom
msg.sender becomes the from address passed into _transfer
setFeeRate additionally requires _msgSender() == _FeeCollectionADD, making authorization depend on the caller
block.timestamp drives the _launchedAt + 3 minutes launch-window restriction inside _transfer
_launchedAt is set to block.timestamp in openTrading and used as a time gate
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline
recipient parameter flows into transfer
amount parameter flows into transfer
sender parameter flows into transferFrom
allowedAmount is the result of the allowance subtraction computed in transferFrom
isBuy flag is forwarded to _tokenTransfer for fee selection
contractTokenBalance is the token amount passed to swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance is passed as the amount to sendETHToFee
tokenAmount parameter flows into swapTokensForEth
amount parameter flows into sendETHToFee
rate parameter is written into _feeRate
newAddress parameter is written into _FeeCollectionADD
bots_ array drives the _isBot writes in setBots
_owned balances are read and written in _transferStandard
balanceOf(_owned) is read for holder and contract balance checks in _transfer
_allowances is read and rewritten by transferFrom
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
_buyFee is read in _getFee
_sellFee is read in _getFee
_FeeCollectionADD is the recipient of ETH in sendETHToFee
_FeeCollectionADD is compared against the caller in setFeeRate
_feeRate scales the impact-fee cap on contractTokenBalance in _transfer
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to and used for impact fee balancing
_tradingOpen gates the pre-swap logic in _transfer
_maxBuyTokens caps the buy amount within the launch window
_maxHeldTokens caps the recipient balance within the launch window
_launchedAt provides the timestamp-based trading window check
_useImpactFeeSetter decides whether the swapped balance is capped in _transfer
uniswapV2Router is invoked inside swapTokensForEth
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH is called in openTrading
_totalSupply is approved to the router in openTrading
owner() is compared against from/to in _transfer
_inSwap set by lockTheSwap around swapTokensForEth provides the reentrancy guard state
transfer calls _transfer
transferFrom calls _transfer
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth on the accumulated contract balance
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
_transfer delegates to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer calls _getFee
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard
_transferStandard calls _getValues
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth
manualsend calls sendETHToFee
openTrading calls _approve before adding liquidity
swapTokensForEth makes an external router swap call which can reenter token transfer flows
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to a mutable address that could reenter
openTrading makes an external addLiquidityETH call that could reenter
_transfer reaches the external router swap, and _inSwap is set only inside swapTokensForEth rather than around the whole transfer
transferFrom computes the new allowance by subtracting amount from the stored allowance

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed transfer; it is fully subsumed by the transfer function node
The amount parameter is only consumed by transfer and aggregates into that function node
The sender parameter is only used inside transferFrom and merges into that function node
The local allowedAmount is the direct result of the allowance subtraction unsafe operation
isBuy is produced in _transfer and immediately fed into _tokenTransfer fee selection
contractTokenBalance is derived in _transfer only to be passed to swapTokensForEth
contractETHBalance is derived in _transfer only to be forwarded to sendETHToFee
tokenAmount is the sole input of swapTokensForEth and merges into it
amount is the sole input of sendETHToFee and merges into it
rate is written into _feeRate by setFeeRate and merges into it
newAddress is written into _FeeCollectionADD by updateTaxAdd and merges into it
bots_ drives the _isBot writes inside setBots and merges into it
